auth.summary:
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair.
The old refresh token is revoked (rotation).
Revoke a refresh token (used on logout).
Get current user info from token. Used for session refresh/validation.
Verify the current user's password. Used for sensitive actions (e.g. currency change).

Change the current user's own password. Requires current password.
Available to any authenticated user.

Reset another user's password (admin action).
- PlatformSuperAdmin / PlatformSupport: can reset any user
- CompanyAdmin: can only reset users within their company

List users that the current admin can manage passwords for.
- PlatformSuperAdmin / PlatformSupport: all users
- CompanyAdmin: users in their company only
Authenticates a mobile user and returns access tokens plus bootstrap payload.
Refreshes a mobile access token using a valid refresh token.
Revokes the active mobile session refresh token.
Registers or updates the authenticated mobile device metadata.
Sends a heartbeat to keep the session active and validate license state.
Requests OTP for mobile login fallback authentication.
Verifies OTP and confirms whether login can proceed.
Checks whether the requested device is authorized for current subscription.

products.summary:
Returns all active products as inventory items for production/custom bouquet builder.
Frontend calls GET /api/inventory/products.
